_about: Default retention periods. The customer (the controller) decides retention for their workers' and contacts' data: they can change any period in their company.json under "retention", and that choice is used and recorded. Defaults follow the GDPR first-pass review of 16 Nov 2026, which still needs an Irish data protection solicitor's sign-off. Until solicitor_confirmed is true, `nightly` reports what it would delete but deletes nothing. `python -m opsengine gdpr purge` applies them (dry run unless --apply).
source: GDPR first-pass review, 16 Nov 2026 (not yet confirmed by a solicitor)

_not_automated.accident_records: 10 years from the accident (S.I. 370/2016, Reg 226). OpsEngine holds accident history at company level only, without names; it is not the system of record for accident reports.
_not_automated.directors_and_owners: contract term + 6 years, deleted at the end of the contract
_not_automated.audit_log: contract term + 6 years; people in it are tokens, and forgetting a person anonymises their entries
